headings.description: Playful, rounded, and friendly font perfect for a kids' brand without being overly childish.

body.description: Clean, highly legible, and soft edges complementing the headings.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Use rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for cards and buttons. Avoid sharp edges to maintain a soft, kid-friendly look.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Extremely generous padding. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections to let the content breathe.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay or organic blob shapes in the background using brand colors at 5-10% opacity.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) with rounded pill-shaped CTA button.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), vibrant colors. Primary: Brand Green or Pink with hover transform (scale-105).
components.cards: Bento-style layout for 'Como Funciona'. Cards must have a white background, soft shadow, and a colored top border or icon background.
components.tabs: Customized Shadcn Tabs for the Menu section. Tab triggers should be pill-shaped. Active tab gets a vibrant background depending on the week color.
components.form: Rounded inputs (rounded-xl), clear labels, generous padding (p-4).
components.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with a stroke-width of 2.5 for a chunkier, friendlier look.

grids.menu_table: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 (Monday to Friday columns)
grids.general: Use CSS Grid for bento layouts. Make sure items are direct children.

layouts.hero: Two-column on desktop (text on left, image on right), stacked on mobile. Title must be massive and playful.
layouts.menu_section: Centered header, followed by Tab list (Normal / Zero Açúcar), followed by Week Selector (1-5), followed by the 5-column daily layout.
layouts.contact: Two-column: Left side with contact info and cute image, Right side with the WhatsApp form.

motion.entrance: Framer Motion staggered fade-up for bento cards and list items.
motion.hover: Buttons and cards should gently lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over colored buttons is white or very dark for >= 4.5:1 contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-pink
accessibility.data_testid: Mandatory on all CTAs, tabs, and form inputs.

media.strategy: Images should have soft rounded corners (rounded-3xl). Use object-cover.

hero.description: Happy child eating, great for Hero section

features.description: Fresh orange juice for 'Suco Natural' card
Colorful fruits for 'Porção de Frutas' card
Healthy lunch box for 'Lanche do Dia' card

parents.description: Girl eating, to be used in 'Para os Pais' or Delivery section

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Fredoka' and 'Nunito' in index.html.
Use standard JS, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn components.

Form submission must prevent default and open WhatsApp link with pre-filled text based on form data: 'https://wa.me/5517996124607?text=Olá, meu nome é [Nome], responsável por [Criança] da escola [Escola]...'

The weekly menu must be interactive. Use a state variable for 'selectedWeek' (1 to 5) and 'menuType' (Normal / Zero). Change the accent color of the active tab based on the selected week (Week 1: Pink, Week 2: Orange, Week 3: Green, etc.).
Section 'Entrega nas Escolas' should have a visually distinct background (e.g., light yellow or teal) to stand out.
Add floating emoji/fruit illustrations or subtle organic blob SVGs in the background to make it playful.
Ensure the hero section uses a soft gradient or off-white background (#FFFDF7).
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; use backdrop-blur with white/80.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
